_template_notes.purpose: Template-only documentation. Do not copy this _template_notes block into product records.

status_vocabulary.Reported: Value printed in the cited source document (archive file or registered external source).
status_vocabulary.Calculated: Numeric value calculated in the record from reported values (e.g. unit conversion, difference, element-based estimate); the calculation is stated in calculation_note. Derived non-numeric classifications stay Reported, with value_kind/basis stating that they are derived.
status_vocabulary.Missing: No value found in any reviewed source; value stays null.
status_vocabulary.Not Applicable: The property does not apply to this product type.
status_vocabulary.Not Required: The property is not required for the documented application (reason stated in notes).

_template_notes.units: Temperatures in °C. Keep printed units as printed (e.g. g/ml, kg/L, cSt, mPa.s); never replace a measured test temperature with a template default.
_template_notes.source: source.file is an archive file name (Manual + Data to share.zip) or an external URL listed in source_registry.json; source.page is the PDF page index (null for web pages); source.revision_date is the document's printed revision or issue date.

optional_provenance_keys.source_documents: Top level: list of documents used for the record (file, pages, doc_type, revision_date, notes).
optional_provenance_keys.external_fill_notes: Top level (additive packages): notes on values filled from sources outside the archive.
optional_provenance_keys.notes / basis: Inside a property: why the cited source supports this exact product and value.
optional_provenance_keys.printed_text: Inside a property: the value exactly as printed.
optional_provenance_keys.calculation_note: Inside a property: derivation of a Calculated value, or a note on a Reported or Missing one.
optional_provenance_keys.alternate_entries: Inside a property: other printed values (e.g. specification limits) kept beside the main value.

_template_notes.conflicts: Top-level 'conflicts' entries record documents or editions that print different values: conflict_type ('edition difference', 'conflicting values between different documents', 'inconsistency within one document' or 'unit or test-condition discrepancy'), field, values[{value, printed_text, file, page, revision_date}], note.
